title: Capture the day-one corpus: 10 rooms and 5 tabletop builds
summary: The Owner scans 10 rooms and 5 tabletop builds with the phone camera app so M1 has a corpus on day one (kit §10 step 4). Raw video goes to gj-capture through the corpus intake path, never into git.

acceptance_tests.test: 10 room walkthrough videos (1–3 min each, chest-height arc, good light) and 5 tabletop orbital videos (slow circle at two heights), phone camera app, handed over per services/reconstruction/corpus/README.md.
At least 3 rooms include the Bible §1 furniture classes (couch, coffee table, dining chair, bookshelf) and at least 2 tabletops are Lego builds.
No faces, documents, screens with personal data, or addresses are visible; GPS off during capture.
acceptance_tests.evidence: Owner confirmation line in the manifest PR

history.event: AUTH #003 applied: acceptance-criterion levels added; iOS-only wording

Owner decision (operator chat): source the corpus from free open-license online videos instead of Owner-shot iPhone scans, and keep it in the private gj-corpus Modal volume (not Supabase). gj-operator sourced 15 clips (10 rooms, 5 tabletops) to gj-corpus:/open-video/ with per-clip meta.json; manifest services/reconstruction/corpus/open_video_corpus.json + OPEN_VIDEO_ATTRIBUTION.md. Status left for the Coordinator (the acceptance tests assume Owner phone captures).

notes: 2026-09-28 deviation from the ATs (Owner-directed): the day-one corpus is an open-license stand-in, not Owner iPhone captures. 15 clips in the private Modal volume gj-corpus under /open-video/{rooms,tabletop}/<slug>/source.mp4 + meta.json (MANIFEST.json, ATTRIBUTION.md at /open-video/); repo record services/reconstruction/corpus/open_video_corpus.json + OPEN_VIDEO_ATTRIBUTION.md. Licenses: Pexels License (10), Pixabay Content License (3), Mixkit Free License (1), CC BY 4.0 ESO (1, credit required); no NC/ND/SA. AT-1: 10 room + 5 tabletop videos exist, but they are stock clips (8-65 s, mostly single passes, several portrait), not 1-3 min chest-height arcs / two-height orbits shot on the Owner's phone or handed over through the intake; manifest.json rows are not used because its schema (source=iphone-camera-app/gj-app, /corpus/ paths, owner_confirmed_clear) describes Owner captures. AT-2: 3+ rooms carry the Bible furniture classes (loft living/dining: couch + dining chair; furniture showroom: couch + coffee table + dining chair + bookshelf; library: bookshelf + chairs; coffee shop: dining chairs), but only 1 tabletop is Lego (ESO LEGO Paranal model): no second open-license Lego clip with usable camera motion was found. AT-3: the clips show no personal documents or addresses; one or two distant people may appear in church-nave-aisle, and GPS/phone settings do not apply. Whether this satisfies M0-OWNER-01 or needs an AT amendment (or a later Owner capture top-up, e.g. a second Lego build) is the Coordinator's call.
